**3.5h**

This session I started and finishedthe starbie project. First, I downloaded KICad and made a github account.  I started by laying out each of the components in the schematic view. Then I arranged these componenents in the PCB editor  and  made the star cutout around them. Finally I followed the tutorial for the code.
